description: SEC-21. Startup fails when a credential is empty or a known default. Debug is off. Security headers include CSP, nosniff, and frame-ancestors none. CORS origins default to an empty list.
scope: Empty and changeme credentials fail startup
Headers and the debug default match the secure set
acceptanceCriteria: validate_startup raises ValueError for admin_key empty, changeme, password, and admin. A random key passes. security_headers includes content-security-policy, x-content-type-options nosniff, and a value containing frame-ancestors 'none'. debug is false and cors_origins is empty. SEC-21.
constraints: Do not start with an empty or default credential.
Do not default debug to true.
Do not default CORS to a wildcard.
